This module implements a highly configurable, thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU)
cache that supports Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration for individual items.

Features:
1.  LRU Eviction Policy: When the cache reaches its maximum size, the least recently
    accessed item is evicted to make room for the new item.
2.  TTL Expiration: Each cached item can have an optional expiration time. If an item
    is accessed after its TTL has expired, it is treated as a cache miss and removed.
3.  Thread-Safety: All public methods are protected by threading locks to ensure
    safe concurrent access from multiple threads.

5.  Comprehensive Test Suite: Uses pytest to verify correctness, thread safety,
    edge cases, and performance characteristics.

Architecture:
    The cache uses a doubly-linked list to maintain the order of access (MRU at the
    head, LRU at the tail) and a hash map (dictionary) to provide O(1) average time
    complexity for lookups and updates.

    The doubly-linked list nodes store:
        - key: The cache key.
        - value: The cached value.
        - ttl: The expiration timestamp for this item.
        - prev: Reference to the previous node.
